Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-28T13:58Z

PR #27215 merged at `c63ce2ad`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On 37 of the 44 paths the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `897e8d89` byte for byte. On the other 7, the PR's net hunks are identical between the merge-base and the merge, and the bytes differ only because other work landed on `main` in between. Those 7 are `field.zod.ts`, `liveness/field.json`, `field.mdx` and the four generated metadata-form translation bundles.

An object can now declare `relatedLists`, which orders the record page's related lists by business importance. An entry is a child object name, or `object.field` for one FK. A field group can declare `relatedList`, so that it stands for a body table; it is `planned` until #27055 draws it. `relatedList: 'primary'` now means placement in the record's main content. An inline-edited `master_detail` child is `primary` by default, so on the tabbed page `crm_opportunity`, `showcase_invoice` and `showcase_expense_report` each gain their own line-items tab. Dangling names are refused at `defineStack` and at the publish door (`related-list-ref-unknown`). ADR-0035 is amended and ADR-0085 carries a §2 note.

The card closed through `Fixes #27069`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
